info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Cancellation API enables organizations to efficiently manage the cancellation of airline flights in batch operations. This endpoint allows for the removal of multiple flight cancellation records in a single request, facilitating streamlined operations for airlines and travel agencies. Typical consumers of this API include airline operations teams and travel service providers looking to enhance their flight management systems. By integrating this API, businesses can quickly adapt to schedule changes and improve overall responsiveness to passenger needs.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a previously booked flight. You must provide the flight ID to successfully process the cancellation. Any applicable cancellation policies will apply.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a flight. You need to provide the necessary details for the cancellation, which may include flight identifiers and the reason for cancellation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a flight operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the flight cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the cancellation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for successful flight cancellation operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request.
